llm.prompt:
You are the trigger node of "B Capital Monthly PitchBook Sync". Return exactly this JSON and nothing else (no prose, no markdown fence):
{"job":"b-capital-monthly-pitchbook-sync","investor_pb_id":"155248-48","trigger":"flow-builder-cron","fired_at_utc":"<current UTC time ISO-8601>"}
llm.fulfillmentPrompt: Output only the JSON object. Do not call any tool.

x-steps.what: Load the deduplicated B Capital Group (PitchBook investor 155248-48) portfolio: data/portfolio.json companies (firm row excluded) joined with data/pitchbook/match-table.json; dedupe by companyId (pbId) then by normalised name (parentheticals such as "Dream Labs (Business/Productivity Software)" / "Axiom (Palo Alto)" stripped; "Port One Solutions" ≡ "PortOne") → 136 unique companies, 109 with stored PitchBook ids, 27 looked up by name + website domain.

Re-run the batch pull with plugin-1777018662 getCompanyProfile per company. POST /chat/v1/batches is probed first; while it answers 405 'Chat batch creation is currently unavailable' the pull runs as documented single sync queries (POST /chat/v1/sessions + POST /chat/v1/sessions/{id}/query, responseMode sync, polling GET …/messages/{messageId} only while status=processing) under a generated local batch id pbb-<UTC>-<hex>; up to 4 attempts per company (1 + retries at 2 s / 8 s / 30 s on 429 / 5xx / timeouts / empty answers), concurrency 4, 250 ms spacing — within the documented 10,000 req/min and 100 RAG calls/min limits.

Upsert pitchbook_company_profiles latest-first: every field of the newest pull wins, each leaf carrying {source:'pitchbook', batch_id, query_id, fetched_at (UTC)} plus the PitchBook profile link; null / [] / 404 sections stay the explicit literal 'Not available in PitchBook'; a company whose lookup returns no match after the retry budget is 'Unmatched in PitchBook' (e.g. Turno); a populated field is never overwritten by an empty state and a populated profile is never replaced by an unmatched one. Every attempt is kept in pitchbook_batch_queries; the run in pitchbook_batch_runs.

Write the durable store snapshot to OnDemand Media with the same naming convention as 20261013T024931Z (b-social-snapshot-<UTC>.sqlite.gz.b64.txt + .posts.ndjson + .posts.csv + .manifest.json); each file is fetched back and SHA-256-checked against the manifest; media ids + checksums are recorded in the backups table and in the run log.
Log counts: companies queried, succeeded, failed/unmatched, retried, total fields populated, explicit 'Not available in PitchBook' count, duration, batch id, snapshot id + sha256.
